videos.title: Houthi Threat Grows as Saudi Pipeline Shutdown Hits Oil
videos.description:
Saudi Arabia faces growing economic pressure as Houthi threats target the kingdom and its East-West oil pipeline could remain mostly shut for six weeks, tightening supply routes around the Red Sea. European oil prices surge as Aramco delays some deliveries, while Russia extends its diesel export ban through September and tighter Chinese fuel stockpiles raise the prospect of export curbs. Oil’s supply-driven rally, however, begins to look overdone.
The US 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% ahead of the Federal Reserve decision, with traders pricing in more than a 90% chance of a rate hike. Bloomberg Economics says Kevin Warsh could leave another hike in play as the Fed is seen potentially raising rates despite pressure from Trump. Markets await the decision as Bessent prepares to meet his Chinese counterpart, with tariffs, US energy and agricultural exports and differences over AI expected on the agenda.
Bitcoin suffers its biggest drop since June after the US Senate blocks a bill, while Bessent says he supports $5,000 checks for Americans and believes they could be funded without increasing the deficit.
In AI, Trump advisers meet with Anthropic executives as OpenAI weighs a funding round valuing the company at $1.2 trillion and works with Anthropic and Google on AI safety. Hong Kong plans to double spending on technology and innovation.
Dubai continues to attract strong global tourism demand, with Kazim saying visitors from the CIS, Far East and Middle East are increasing, although the city remains reliant on Emirates and flydubai to bring in tourists.
In Africa, El Niño is straining Ethiopia’s power supply as drying dams force cuts to Bitcoin miners, who consume almost a third of the country’s electricity. Senegal seeks a debt plan under the G20 framework, the US restricts visa access for some South Africans, and Vodacom plans to appeal a ruling involving its Safaricom stake sale. Guests includes Jeffrey Sexton, Demeter Tactical Investments CEO, Issam Kazim, Dubai Corp for Tourism and Commerce Marketing CEO and Guy Wolf, Marex Market Analytics Global Head.

Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. Live from Dubai, we bring you the latest global markets and analysis, plus news-making interviews, with a special focus on MEA. All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg.

videos.title: Supporting Rohingya and Host Communities in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
videos.description:
Since 2017, more than one million Rohingya have taken shelter in Cox’s Bazar in Bangladesh, placing pressure on local services and infrastructure. The World Bank is helping provide essential services for displaced Rohingya people and host communities—from water, sanitation, health and nutrition to food security, safety, protection, and resilience. These efforts are helping improve daily life, strengthen resilience, and support dignity for displaced Rohingya until the safe and voluntary return and the host community.

videos.title: How Better Roads Are Transforming Communities in Laos
videos.description:
The World Bank Southeast Asia Regional Economic Corridor and Connectivity Project is upgrading an Asian Highway and streamlining border procedures to increase job opportunities through better connectivity across Thailand, the Lao PDR, and Viet Nam. In northern Laos, the project is revitalizing communities by improving secondary roads that connect to rural villages, improving road safety, and increasing access to markets, public services, and opportunities.

Learn more: https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2026/07/23/corridor-to-trade-jobs-and-services?cid=ECR_YT_Worldbank_EN_EXT

videos.title: هل تعتقد أن الوظيفة هي الطريقة الوحيدة للعمل مع البنك الدولي؟ فكّر مرة أخرى
videos.description:
هل ترغب بالعمل مع مجموعة البنك الدولي بدون الحاجة إلى التقديم لوظيفة؟ اكتشف كيفية العثور على مشاريع المشتريات والعقود المربحة التي تقدمها مجموعة البنك الدولي، والمشاركة في المناقصات، والفوز بها.
يمكنك الوصول إلى الأدوات والإرشادات والتنبيهات على منصة البنك الدولي الخاصة بالموردين: http://wrld.bg/YG1v50Z4Ul7 من خلال منصة مجموعة البنك الدولي للموردين، تستطيع الشركات من جميع الأحجام الحصول على تمويل بمليارات الدولارات لمشاريع عالمية. يشرح هذا الفيديو كيفية إيجاد فرص التوريد، والتعامل مع منهجية التوريد المُحدَّثة، والمنافسة بنزاهة على العقود في مجالات السلع والأعمال والخدمات. مع أكثر من 1600 مشروع نشط في أكثر من 100 دولة، تشمل المشتريات الممولة من البنك الدولي ما يلي: الأعمال المدنية والمعدات أنظمة تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاستشارات خدمات فنية متخصصة للشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة والشركات العالمية ما الجديد في هذا الإطار المُحدَّث؟ يركز النظام الجديد على أفضل قيمة (وليس مجرد أفضل سعر)، والمشاركة المبكرة في السوق، وخيارات دفع أفضل، ونظام شكاوى قوي لضمان عملية اختيار عادلة وشفافة. تعرّف على المزيد وسجّل عملك اليوم: http://wrld.bg/YG1v50Z4Ul7 


🌐 تعد مجموعة البنك الدولي واحدة من أكبر مصادر التمويل والمعرفة في العالم بالنسبة للبلدان المنخفضة الدخل. تشترك مؤسساتها الخمس في الالتزام بالحد من الفقر وزيادة الرخاء المشترك وتعزيز التنمية المستدامة. http://www.albankaldawli.org
